text: COMBOBOX TAKES SEVERAL ANSWERS, AND IS NOW A FORM FIELD LIKE THE REST. `<Combobox multiple>` makes `value` a `string[]`: chosen options sit in the field as removable chips, the list stays open between choices, Enter toggles, Backspace in an empty box removes the last chip, and each change is announced. `maxSelected` caps the answer and `maxVisibleChips` folds a long one into “+N more”. Both modes are now built on FormField and the Input shell, so the label, gap, 44px box, 8px corner, hint and error match every field beside them (they sat 8px high and 6px short before), and gain `size`, `warning`, `success`, `labelHelp`, `optional` and `readOnly`. Also new: `name` for native form posts, a server search (`onQueryChange`, `filterOptions`, `minQueryLength`, `loading`, `loadError`, `onRetry`), `maxResults`, grouped options (`group`), an upward list near the foot of the viewport, and Enter ignored during IME composition. A touch that starts a scroll no longer chooses the option under it. In Figma: a new Combobox page (Combobox and Combobox / Multiple, 36 variants each; Combobox / Option; Combobox / List with nine list states), a documentation frame with a Growth section showing chips that wrap, fold and push a form row down, a component record, an Index card, and Code Connect for all three placeable sets. Chip / Input (26px, removable) joins the Chips page; its height and remove button are now the tokens cmp/chip/heightSm and cmp/chip/dismissSize, replacing two literals in chip.css.
